prerequisites: Knowledge of the fundamentals of design engineering including CAD
3.0/2.0 ECTS/SWS Lecture Fundamentals of Design Engineering
Successful completion of the StEOP (Study Entrance and Orientation Phase)

learning_outcomes.text: Systematically analyze requirements, boundary conditions, and conflicting objectives of technical products.
Derive consistent product requirements and functional structures from given customer requirements and technical boundary conditions, and transfer them into a task definition.
Purposefully select methodical product development models (e.g., VDI 2221, TRIZ, QFD, Value Analysis) from available options for specific development tasks.
Assess variants of technical product concepts regarding function, cost, development time, and risk using suitable evaluation methods.
Systematically develop technical products from the early concept phase to series production using structured development and design steps.
Conceive measures to shorten product development time (e.g., Simultaneous Engineering, Concurrent Engineering, Rapid Prototyping) for given development processes.
Critically examine safety, reliability, and quality relevant requirements for products, including associated design guidelines.
Efficiently organize development and design tasks in a team, considering time and resource constraints.
Compile results of own product development projects in an audience-appropriate manner.
Discuss results critically and constructively, for example, within the framework of peer feedback.

syllabus_topics: General methods (Construction science model, TRIZ method, Value analysis, ABC analysis, Working with design catalogs, Quality Function Deployment, etc.)
Guidelines for the design of technical systems
